CollectionDesc:
*<size=-2>Polish the purified amber until it shines bright beneath starlight, thus rendering its existence eternal, and its collapse as steady as its inception.
Communer! Give your oath here! Give THEM your wealth, your love, your everything.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: Increases the max DMG absorption of the shield received by characters in Divergent Universe by <unbreak>2%</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc:
*<size=-2>Harvest a thread of shimmering memories that have tears within moments of joy, and let these memories be dissolved in a sea of time, engraving their instants upon eternity.
Communer! Stride forth. Peel the decay from this husk and escape into translucent dreams of old.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: Increases the Effect Hit Rate by characters in Divergent Universe by <unbreak>4%</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc:
*<size=-2>Scoop out the Nihility-gnawed heart and see its emptiness, see the Boreholes lining its shape, as if moments from collapse, just as if existence itself.
Communer! Close your eyes and leap forth. Seek the boundless abyss.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: Increases the DoT dealt by characters in Divergent Universe by <unbreak>3%</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc:
*<size=-2>Verdant branches taken from within your eyes. The extraction came without pain, and the new sprouts grow yet, nourishing all the living THEY do so pity.
Communer! Bow your head in prayer. Let there be no more suffering. Let the streams never dry.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: Increases characters' HP restored in Divergent Universe by <unbreak>2%</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc:
*<size=-2>The air passed through the skies and pierced the universe, collecting the scattered fragments, assembling perished companions of gallantry to smite evil.
Communer! Please draw the bowstring, and hark the lonesome cries of geese, and bring forth the manifestation of legions.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: Increases the CRIT DMG of characters in Divergent Universe by <unbreak>3%</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc:
*<size=-2>Cup a handful of lava of greater heat than even an anti-matter body from the deepest pits of purgatory. Destruction congeals. Civilizations disintegrate. Annihilation cycles eternal.
Communer! Shatter the lock, and let obliteration and ignition become our perfect offering.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: Increases the DMG of characters in Divergent Universe by <unbreak>2%</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc:
*<size=-2>Serendipitously pick up a ball and paint faces upon its surface with abandon. These faces are but clownish visages, and of the emotions, only Elation remains.
Communer! Don't be so serious. The taverns are filled with friends, and The Laughter is with you.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: In Divergent Universe, Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt by characters increases by <unbreak>3%</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc:
*<size=-2>The structure dissolves, the outer shell ossifies, the nerves incur the squirming of the chrysalises, summoning the arrival of weightlessness.
Communer! Succumb to slumber. Let your genes decide your past, let your instincts decide your future.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: In Divergent Universe, Basic ATK DMG dealt by characters increases by <unbreak>3%</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc:
*<size=-2>An Intellitron shell imbued with sentience. This creation is Stephen Lloyd's pride and joy.
Output: Beacon locked. Initiating warp.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by characters in Divergent Universe by <unbreak>3%</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc:
*<size=-2>An Intellitron shell imbued with sentience. This creation is Stephen Lloyd's pride and joy.
Output: Sector scan complete. Beginning replacement.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: Increases the ATK of characters in Divergent Universe by <unbreak>2%</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc:
*<size=-2>An Intellitron shell imbued with sentience. This creation is Stephen Lloyd's pride and joy.
Output: Data inputted. Loading applied module.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: Increases the DEF of characters in Divergent Universe by <unbreak>2%</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc:
*<size=-2>An Intellitron shell imbued with sentience. This creation is Stephen Lloyd's pride and joy.
Output: Attempt <unbreak>103818</unbreak> at Intra-Cognition.
Output: Attempt failed.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: Increases the Max HP of characters in Divergent Universe by <unbreak>2%</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc: *<size=-2>The great Madam Herta. Even as but a puppet, her every action is suffused with colorful intellect.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the Divergent Universe Curio store in Store Domains will increase the amount of purchasable Curios by <unbreak>1</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc:
*<size=-2>"The lost seeker found traces of truth in the mist. And so, he found back to the material world."
<align="right">— Fables About the Stars by Adrian Spencer Smith</align></size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the starting Cosmic Fragments amount in the Divergent Universe increases by <unbreak>20</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc: *<size=-2>The infinite layers of shells encase the ruler of the infinite universe, yet even so, she continues to turn the key, opening the next door infinitely.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the Heat usable for Blessing Enhancement increases by 1 point in the Divergent Universe First Plane's Workbench of Creation.

CollectionDesc:
*<size=-2>So you're saying that Professor Ratio, whose pass rate is like the gacha rates in the Interastral Peace Entertainment's blind boxes, actually passed you? Stop pulling my leg.</size>*
*<size=-2>...</size>*
*<size=-2>What, are you serious?</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the amount of Cosmic Fragments needed to overwrite Equations in the Divergent Universe's Workbench of Creation decreases by <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc: *<size=-2>Hey, don't touch my tail when I'm asleep!</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, receive <unbreak>1</unbreak> attempts to reset Blessings for free in the Divergent Universe Third Plane's Workbench of Creation.

CollectionDesc:
*<size=-2>"What are you carving on the tombstone, one-eyed poet?"</size>*
*<size=-2>"Proof of our existence."</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, recover <unbreak>2</unbreak> Technique Point(s) after entering a Boss Domain in Divergent Universe.

CollectionDesc: *<size=-2>A crystal relief modeled after Command Spells, engraved with the hero's past.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the Cosmic Fragments obtained after a battle victory in the Divergent Universe increases by 1.

CollectionDesc: *<size=-2>The sheath of Excalibur faintly visible within the illusion, is like the continuation of a dream.</size>*
CollectionEffectDesc: After this item is placed in the Probability Museum, restores HP equal to <unbreak>20%</unbreak> of Max HP for all allies when entering a domain in Divergent Universe.

CollectionDesc: Intellitron bodies are built for freedom. In theory, Pearl really could upload her consciousness into this model... if the network wasn't blocked.
CollectionEffectDesc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the Divergent Universe Blessing store in "Store" Domains will increase the amount of purchasable Blessings by <unbreak>1</unbreak>.

CollectionDesc: When you don't think it's funny, just give us a smile. A smile is the gentlest invention in the world, and it never needs a reason.
CollectionEffectDesc: Increases characters' Elation by <unbreak>3%</unbreak> in Divergent Universe.
